title: Report to the Guard Captain
description: Wex is alive. Toma is not. Report to the guard captain in Thornfield and let him decide what Toma's mother is told.

objectives.description: Report the patrol's fate to the guard captain

notes: Closing beat carries the cost: a captain who gets one man back and has to write a letter about the other. No mechanical consequence for Toma's death is wired - recorded as a second path (a condolence/blame branch with the captain) this pass could not build.
